verdict.rationale: Paxos documents a dedicated Developer Sandbox that uses test funds and testnet/devnet assets to mock flows, execute transfers and test integrations, so testing stays separate from production. This is a true sandbox environment, not just a dry-run mode. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the sandbox, and parity beyond 'core v2 API functionality' (the Dashboard Fund button supports only USD and Paxos-issued stablecoins).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Use the Sandbox environment to mock flows, execute transfers and test integrations.
The Developer Sandbox replicates core v2 API functionality with an automated system that uses test funds to simulate normal activities
Source test crypto assets from faucets and deposit them into your Sandbox account for end-to-end integration testing.
When you create a deposit address in Sandbox, the generated address can be used to transfer test assets from a testnet or devnet wallet to the Paxos platform.
